plugins.name: sweeps
plugins.description: Two paired repository sweeps with opposite calibrations: truing finds what a repo says that is not so, parsimony proposes what should stop existing.

plugins.name: noun
plugins.description: The Noun Project icon API, as one skill: sign a request with the keys in the environment, search and fetch icons, download them in a colour, and mind the quota and the attribution.

plugins.name: rung
plugins.description: A structured discussion that leaves one person understanding something: an interviewer probes first, a dense expert statement stands as the pillar, and every later part is written on demand one rung down, in an anchored voice edited by seats that argue by letter and checked against the world.
